overview.description: The secret to adapting any protocol is to KNOW YOUR ORGANISM. If a protocol says 37C but your critter prefers 30C, you can make the expert decision to optimise. An abundance of literature is your friend.
objectives: identify the optimal growth temperature and media for your host
learn to adapt protocols to non-E. coli organisms

instructions.title: Research your organism
instructions.description: Google culture conditions, ideal media, growth curves, morphology - anything that improves your success rate.

instructions.title: Standardise E. coli conditions
instructions.description: For E. coli: 37C, shaking ~100-200 rpm for liquid culture, LB media.

instructions.title: Document deviations
instructions.description: Record any condition where your organism differs from the default protocol so you can adapt every downstream step.

submission.description: Produce a one-page 'organism profile': optimal temperature, media, doubling time, and any special handling notes.
